description: This is a Java unit test class for CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing creation and error handling scenarios for live command answers related to 'CreateThing' commands within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for CreateThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl, testing answer building logic for create thing commands in a live signal scenario.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and test setup before each test case.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Tests that creating a new instance with null command throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.description: Tests building a LiveCommandAnswer with a 'created' response, verifying no event and correct response type.

methods.description: Tests building a LiveCommandAnswer with a 'conflict' error response, verifying exception types and headers.
